purpose: Teach: 持ち込む/値引き/コツコツ/売店/上層/掛かり/精算/夜勤

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新研究、本気で、絶対、持ち込む、絶対、教授、絶対、相談しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — bring that new research to the professor. I'm serious. Go talk to them.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Weight behind each instruction. Leans forward slightly. The tone of someone who's seen enough to know what matters. A pause before the final push.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会、本気で、絶対、値引き、絶対、参加費、絶対、利用しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The conference discount was incredibly helpful. I really do appreciate it.
lines.style: Respectful, straightforward. Eye contact held steady. Not deferential — genuinely grateful. A slight warmth under the formality, like he means it without overdoing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、本気で、絶対、コツコツ、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — keep moving forward with the research. Steady work, day by day.
lines.style: Patient but clear. No rush in the pacing, but no room for doubt either. Settling back in his seat. The counsel of someone who's weathered projects before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学内、本気で、絶対、売店、絶対、で、絶対、よく、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、買います、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've been buying coffee from the campus shop pretty regularly. Thank you for thinking of that.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. A slight smile underneath the words — not forced. He's noticed the small thing and is saying so without making it bigger than it is.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学界、本気で、絶対、上層、絶対、部、絶対、にも、絶対、人脈を、絶対、作れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — build connections in the upper levels of the academic world too. It matters.
lines.style: Firmer now, more insistent. Taps the emphasis on 'build.' Still measured, but there's urgency beneath it. He's not asking for agreement, he's ensuring understanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、本気で、絶対、掛かり、絶対、長、絶対、ご指導いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The lab director has been guiding me carefully through everything. I'm very grateful for that support.
lines.style: Calm and measured. Acknowledging the guidance without over-explaining. A slight nod in his voice. The words of someone who understands he's being looked after.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、出張費、本気で、絶対、精算、絶対、早めにしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — submit those travel expense receipts early. Don't let them pile up.
lines.style: Practical, almost fatherly. No ceremony. The advice of someone who knows the small administrative details trip people up. Steady but not unkind.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験で、本気で、絶対、夜勤、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've been working night shifts for the experiments. I really do appreciate all your patience with that.
lines.style: Tired but present. A slight catch in the voice — the fatigue is real. But he's not complaining, just stating it. Genuine thanks underneath, even if his energy is lower.
